title: Customer Care Advisor

title: Customer Service Administrator
description: Maternity Cover - Customer Service Administrator (1-year Fixed-Term Contract) Reports to: Customer Service Manager Location: Reigate Salary: 27,150 Per Annum Hours: 8:45 am-5:00 pm (30-minute lunch) Must be able to drive Lloyd Recruitment Services is glad to be working with our long-standing client, who is looking for a proactive Customer Service Administrator. You will play a key role in delivering an excellent customer experience, ensuring that all customer enquiries, orders, repairs, servicing requests and returns are managed efficiently, professionally and proactively. The role involves building strong working relationships with both internal and external sales teams, customers and colleagues across the business. A friendly, empathetic and professional approach is essential, alongside a willingness to communicate confidently with customers both over the telephone and face-to-face. Key Responsibilities: Customer Support and Client Relationships - Provide a high level of customer care through a range of communication methods, including phone calls, emails and in-person contact. - Establish and maintain positive relationships with customers, colleagues and sales teams, both internally and externally. - Respond to customer questions and concerns in a helpful, understanding and professional manner, ensuring individual needs are taken into consideration. - Act as a key contact for customers, offering guidance, setting clear expectations and keeping them updated on orders, repairs and servicing requirements. - Liaise with relevant colleagues to resolve issues and ensure customers receive an effective and positive service. Sales Orders and Order Processing - Manage incoming customer orders, ensuring all details are entered correctly and processed within the required timescales. - Take responsibility for tracking orders through each stage, from initial placement to final delivery. - Keep track of outstanding orders, highlighting any issues or possible delays and taking appropriate action. - Prepare customer invoices and undertake any related paperwork or administrative tasks. - Organise the preparation and movement of goods, including packaging, dispatches, collections and deliveries. - Work alongside other departments to ensure customer and order information is kept up to date and recorded accurately. Product Repairs, Returns and Warranty Administration - Deal with incoming repair and servicing requests, covering both warranty and chargeable work, ensuring these are logged and progressed accordingly. - Oversee the return of goods, including exchanges, replacements and product swaps, in line with internal processes. - Book and coordinate courier arrangements for the collection and return of products, monitoring each stage to ensure smooth delivery. - Ensure all returned items are checked in, documented and directed to the appropriate department or process. - Keep repair and warranty documentation up to date, providing customers with regular progress information and assistance where needed. Teamwork, Office & Operational Support - Work closely with colleagues across departments, maintaining clear communication and a positive team environment. - Help maintain a clean, organised and safe workplace, following all relevant company, health and safety, fire and security procedures. - Provide support to the warehouse when required, including deliveries, stock checks and despatch activities. - Keep customer and business records up to date using internal systems and CRM, recording communications accurately. - Contribute to improving administrative processes and assist with product testing or demonstrations when needed. - Take responsibility for daily tasks, remain flexible and offer support across the business during busy periods. About you: - Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and build rapport with a variety of customers and colleagues. - Excellent organisational abilities, with a methodical approach and a good eye for detail. - The confidence to work independently, use initiative and balance several tasks and deadlines. - A positive team attitude, with the flexibility to work across different areas of the business when needed. - Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including a basic understanding of Excel and Zoho Books. - Previous experience in an administrative, customer support or order processing position would be an advantage. - Familiarity with CRM platforms would be beneficial.
